shows.title: Erebus
shows.description: EREBUS is a forty-five minute immersive haunted experience. In small groups, you will witness three directors' theatrical take on horror within the avant-garde. Important Information: You will be moving through dimly lit environments as part of the experience, with uneven flooring at times. There will be instances of strobe lighting, simulated violence and blood, nudity, and loud sounds.

shows.title: Santa's First Christmas
shows.description: Santa spends every Christmas Eve spreading joy around the world. He's so busy that he never gets the chance to celebrate himself - but this year his loyal, big-hearted elves are on a mission to give him the best Christmas ever. With a huge tree, lots of tasty treats and plenty of festive cheer, Santa joins in the fun and discovers the true magic of Christmas, for the very first time!
